description: A station's departures on a day toward every destination, from its timetable: TRA, THSR or a metro (including Taipei Metro, whose live board shows arrivals only). Use tra_timetable or thsr_timetable for trains between two stations. Example: system "TRA", station "板橋"; or system "TRTC", station "台北車站", toward "淡水".

after.description: Only departures at or after this time, HH:mm (default: now for today, else 00:00).

date.description: Travel date in Taiwan, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

limit.description: Maximum number of departures to return (default 20).

station.description: Station name in Chinese or English (台北, 板橋, Ximen) or station ID.

system.description: Rail system: TRA (臺鐵), THSR (高鐵) or a metro: TRTC 臺北捷運 Taipei Metro, NTMC 新北捷運 (環狀線) New Taipei Metro, TYMC 桃園機場捷運 Taoyuan Airport MRT, TMRT 臺中捷運 Taichung MRT, KRTC 高雄捷運 Kaohsiung MRT, KLRT 高雄輕軌 Kaohsiung LRT.

toward.description: Only trains whose terminus contains this, e.g. "淡水" or "Kaohsiung".

name: rail_station_departures
title: Station departures
